verdict.rationale: Replit's built-in Agent takes delegated work. It breaks work into reviewable tasks, runs them as background threads in isolated project copies, and turns recurring jobs into scheduled routines that report back. It also provisions auth and databases and builds sites from templates, with selectable Free, Power and Max modes. Community reports confirm the agent acts autonomously (a positive vibe-coding review, plus incidents of it running git operations and deleting a production database). Those incidents raise reliability concerns but do not contradict that delegation works. Missing for 10: evidence of safeguards or approval controls that make delegated actions safe, given the reported destructive-action incidents.
